title: Post-Market Evaluation of HEMOBLAST™ Bellows in Open Gynecological, Urological, ENT, Head, Neck, and Vascular Surgeries
brief_summary: A prospective, multi-center, multi-national single arm study to evaluate the performance and safety of HEMOBLAST™ Bellows in open gynecological, urological, ENT and head and neck, and vascular surgery.
study_population: Subjects undergoing open gynecological, urological, ENT and head and neck, and vascular procedures that meet all of the inclusion criteria and none of the exclusion criteria.
